utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren, that helps a lot. We’re still looking for a few more helpers for Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Tess. I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam. I’m still lining up a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so I’ll keep you posted on the parking and tool drop-off plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Vik. Keep me posted, and I’ll help however I can when the plan is set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds workable, as long as the parking and tool drop-off are clearly marked so people aren’t circling around. Do you know if we have enough helpers lined up yet?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, we’ve got a few helpers lined up already, and I’m making sure the parking and tool drop-off are clearly marked so folks can get in and out easily.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can do that. I’ll be on the porch at 10 to greet people and sort tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps a lot, Mina. Thank you for being there at 10 and helping sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re still short a couple hands for Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way. I’m trying to keep the setup simple and practical so we can get moving fast.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around, but I want to be sure we have enough parking and a clear tool drop-off spot by the porch first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would be great, thanks. I’m still lining up a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam. That helps a lot - I’ll put you on greetings and parts at 10 a.m. so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll be there at 10 and keep an eye on the parts table.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
